content:
**Shenandoah Visitor Center** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

Operated by the National Park Service, the Shenandoah Visitor Center welcomed guests to Shenandoah National Park and hosted the yearly Shenandoah Halloween Spooktacular. [1] The center was run by Head Park Ranger Francine, and staffed by Kevin Harris and Elenora. An incident occurred which caused Francine to "deal with" the involved individuals and issue a warning that any further "accusations" will be met with a month's suspension without pay. On August 27th, a memorial to Ranger Gloria Morelli was unveiled outside the center, with Kevin and Francine speaking for the event. [2] 

After the Great War in February, a group of 10 settlers from Washington, D.C. arrived in the Visitor Center in February with the intent of living there, noting that someone had moved taxidermized multiple animals and put them on display since the war. [3] The group settled in the station's basement, with Dr. Glenn MacLeod establishing a small infirmary with a terminal he had collected from the station's main floor. By May the group had become aware of the presence of the lone surviving park ranger, Kevin Harris living in the attached Ranger Station Bunker, but believed him to be a ghost. They also deemed that the presence of dangerous wildlife such as Thrashers made long journeys too dangerous. [4] 

In September, William Kidd accidentally shot his toe off while playing with his revolver and envisioning himself as a cowboy, and was brought to see Dr. MacLeod by his father, Archie. The toe was unrecoverable. [4] In November, a group of survivors made up of Hogarth Hendricks, Skirving, and Redwood were scavenging near Watoga when they were caught in the crossfire between a group of Scorched and Super Mutants. Hendricks was exposed to the toxic cloud emanated from a Scorchbeast and was infected with the Scorched Plague. By the time of the group's return to the visitor center Hendricks was nearly dead, and within hours he had succumbed to the plague and began attempting to choke Dr. MacLeod to death. Hendricks was killed when Macleod stabbed him through the Left Orbital into his Temporal Lobe with a Stimpak. The medical room was quarantined to prevent the potential spread of the plague, until the group's evacuation from the visitor center and journey north in January following the creation of The Storm. [4] 

The center has since became a home to Mothman Cultists.

Shenandoah Visitor Center appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.
